name: knot
archive_reason: Testbed for AIKit itself: used to validate the full-history Reforge host-review, repair and delivery workflow end to end (32 commits, 264 hunks attested, 17 fixes, 710 checks). No further development planned.
archive_description: [ARCHIVED] Knot is a zero-dependency C++17 include-graph analyzer for programmers: it parses include directives with an explicit state machine, detects cycles, quantifies transitive header cost, traces the exact include chain that pulls a header in, reports the reverse blast radius of changing a header, diffs a tree against a recorded baseline...
